intro: Use the current editorial mailbox for corrections, accessibility problems, privacy requests and general questions about BettaFish.website.

sections.heading: Email the editorial team

sections.heading: What this channel covers
paragraphs: Readers can report factual errors, broken pages, accessibility problems and privacy concerns. Include the affected URL and enough detail for the issue to be reproduced or checked.
The contact channel will not provide individualized veterinary diagnosis or emergency treatment instructions.
